name: Nothing to Serve
description: Viktor suspects the shortage is not an accident. Ask Zofia and Pavel why official supply manifests no longer match what arrives.
offerText: Ask Zofia when food and drinks will arrive.

stages.description: Ask Zofia when food and drinks will arrive.
Ask Pavel about the shortages. Ask why the official inventory calls the missing goods an emergency redistribution.
Return to Viktor with the answer.

_codex.narrativeIntent: Zofia and Pavel give different bureaucratic explanations for the missing deliveries.
implementationNotes: Pavel uses phrase administrative redistribution; Viktor is unconvinced.
